sourceFiles.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE small app AI assistant interaction-state icon with genuine transparent alpha background. Reference 1 is the approved NEW blue cloud chat mascot: preserve its canonical sky-blue scalloped cloud body, large rounded top dome, compact body proportions, same dark vertical oval eye size and spacing, single white eye catchlights, tiny curved brows, pink oval cheeks, mitten hands and short arms. Crisp flat cartoon sticker style, bold rounded deep ink #252436 outlines, sky-blue #91c9ff, pink #ffa9c3, ivory #fffdf7 speech bubble with three dark dots. Keep small hard dark offset shadow tucked behind lower-right contour. No 3D, no realistic texture, no white sticker halo, no floor shadow or ellipse, no book, no extra characters, no text or labels, no tile or enclosing frame. Reference 2 is ONLY a pose/cropping/state guide for the old purple icon: copy its function and docking orientation but do NOT use the purple color, white outline, tail or facial design. Design for legibility at 62-76px. One clear icon, large on a square transparent canvas. RIGHT EDGE IDLE PEEKING state. Blue cloud peeks in from the RIGHT edge of screen, with a vertical crop flush at canvas right boundary, approximately the outer quarter of body extends out of frame. The two eyes, full face, smile, cheek marks and large top lobe remain visible left of the cropped edge. On the LEFT, one short mitten arm makes a friendly wave toward page center. Small ivory three-dot speech bubble sits near the LOWER LEFT next to the cloud, completely visible with clean gap, bubble width about 28% cloud width. Relaxed eyes open and warm small smiling mouth. No second arm clutter. This is a restrained docked peeking pose, NOT the full-body free-floating cloud. Position the cropped cloud flush right with no transparent gutter on right, generous clear transparency left and above.
